description: Use this when the user states a spending limit for a project. It records their ceiling; it never authorises a purchase. Set a monthly or yearly budget for a project, in cents. Records a number you chose. Cannot spend money and cannot buy anything. The response comes back with the project's CURRENT CARRY and HEADROOM already computed, because a budget with no carry beside it is a number rather than information. Headroom is flagged `partial` whenever the project contains a domain whose renewal price is unknown — a renewal we cannot price is counted as unknown, NEVER as zero, so headroom is an upper bound in that case and real headroom is lower.PRICES ARE IDENTICAL FOR ALL BUYERS REGARDLESS OF BUDGET. A budget changes what is recommended and how results are ordered; it never changes what anything costs.
name: set_budget
